question: Should the exact CAL-PLAN-0004 revision 1 candidate be accepted so the additive CTXMAP2-S1 successor-map authorship stage becomes separately executable?

options.label: Accept exact plan and make CTXMAP2-S1 eligible
options.benefit: Starts with the smallest dependency-closing proof and preserves every admitted runtime and v1 map byte.
options.cost_or_risk: Adds a new map-review step before Rust export.
options.downstream_effect: Only the nine-path additive v2 map candidate scope becomes eligible under CA2-ROUTE-IMPLEMENT; later D65 and cutover gates remain closed.

options.label: Require amendments
options.benefit: Changes layer boundaries or evidence requirements before execution.
options.cost_or_risk: Requires a new immutable plan revision and validation receipt.

options.label: Defer
options.benefit: Preserves the candidate and admitted runtime without new work.
options.cost_or_risk: The adapters remain isolated and v2 cutover remains unavailable.

options.label: Stop
options.benefit: Terminates the successor cleanly while retaining evidence.
options.cost_or_risk: No public adapter export or v2 runtime cutover will be pursued under this plan.

non_effects: This request is not a selection or owner decision.
It does not authorize mutation of the admitted runtime or v1 Context Map.
It does not authorize adapter export, migration, cutover, publication, release, deployment, or external effect.
